title: GoldenTestCase
description: Schema for YAML test case files in testdata/cases/. Each file describes one model + one input scenario for L4/L5 golden tests.

model_type.description: Registry model_type key (e.g. 'llama', 'qwen2'). Must match a key in mobius._registry.

revision.description: HuggingFace model revision: a full commit SHA (preferred for reproducibility) or 'main'.

task_type.description: Task type string matching the mobius registry.

repository.description: HuggingFace repository containing the GGUF artifact.

tensor_qtypes.description: Expected GGUF tensor census keyed by qtype name.

execution_provider.description: Exact execution provider used when constructing the evidenced route.

config_sha256.description: Expected canonical hash of the config extracted from GGUF metadata.

preserve_quantization.description: Expected import-route result after considering the source qtypes.

keep_quantized.description: Whether to preserve supported GGUF quantization.

gguf.description: Pinned GGUF import source. The top-level model_id remains the independent HuggingFace reference.

level.description: Test level(s) to run: L4 (checkpoint verified), L5 (generation E2E), or both.

prompts.description: Text prompts for text-generation, feature-extraction, seq2seq, and image-text-to-text tasks.

images.description: Image file paths relative to testdata/ (vision and vision-language tasks).

videos.description: Video file paths relative to testdata/ (video-language tasks).

video_num_frames.description: Optional deterministic frame count for video-language preprocessing.

media_max_pixels.description: Optional deterministic per-image/frame pixel budget for multimodal golden tests.

audio.description: Audio file paths relative to testdata/ (speech tasks).

decoder_prompt.description: Forced decoder prefix for seq2seq / encoder-decoder tasks. Empty string means no forced prefix.

inputs.description: Input data for the test case. All sub-fields are optional.

max_new_tokens.description: Maximum number of new tokens to generate.

do_sample.description: Whether to use sampling. false = greedy decoding (required for reproducible golden tests).

eos_token_id.description: End-of-sequence token ID. Overrides the model's default to ensure generation stops correctly.

exact_match.description: Require the generated token IDs, sequence length, and decoded text to match the L5 golden exactly.

lang.description: Target language code for multilingual models (e.g. MMS uses ISO-639-3 codes like 'eng' to pick the per-language adapter).

target_model_id.description: Paired target model HF ID for speculative-decoding drafter tasks (e.g. dflash-draft): the target supplies the hidden states / shared KV used to build the drafter's golden inputs at generation time. Only read by generate_golden.py; the e2e test replays stored tensors and never loads the target.

generation.description: HuggingFace GenerationConfig overrides. Only applicable for L5 generation tests.

trust_remote_code.description: Whether the HuggingFace model requires trust_remote_code=True.

reference_loader.description: HuggingFace loader used to generate the reference. Use multimodal when a text-only export is sourced from a composite checkpoint.

skip_reason.description: If non-null/non-empty, the test is skipped with this message. Use for known failures or unimplemented features.

ci_skip_reason.description: If non-null/non-empty and skip_reason is unset, the test is skipped in CI (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true) but runs locally. skip_reason takes precedence when both are set. Use for models that are too large for CI hardware. Does NOT block golden data generation.

min_token_match_ratio.description: Per-case L5 tolerance override for token match ratio. Overrides the global value in default_tolerances.yaml. Use when the model has known float32 precision divergence vs HuggingFace (e.g. VL 3-model pipeline accumulates rounding error over decode steps).

notes.description: Human-readable description of the test case. Not parsed by the test runner.

real_weight_validation.description: Record of an out-of-band validation run against the official checkpoint, for cases whose checked-in golden is a reduced-config reference and whose real weights are too large for CI. Not parsed by the test runner; it documents evidence a reviewer would otherwise have to take on trust.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint and revision the run used, including its size.

hardware.description: Accelerator, driver, and peak memory the run needed.

upstream.description: Reference implementation and the exact generation settings it ran with.

export.description: Mobius export configuration under test (dtype, execution provider, sub-models).

component_parity.description: Per-component agreement with the reference, keyed by sub-model name.

end_to_end.description: Whole-pipeline agreement with the reference, keyed by the execution path measured.

architecture.description: Optional registry architecture key (e.g. Qwen35MtpModel) forcing a specific module class + task at build time. Needed for auxiliary heads (DFlash, MTP) that share a base checkpoint whose architectures field would otherwise auto-route to the base model.
